args.summary: Following the deploy of v2.3.1, checkout-api began failing health checks in production. Rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to the most recent healthy release, v2.3.0. Post-rollback verification: service healthy in all regions, running v2.3.0, error rate 0.2%.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
All done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Reviewed deployment history** for checkout-api: the latest deploy, **v2.3.1**, was unhealthy in production. The most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back** checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback verified successfully.
3. **Confirmed recovery**: service is healthy in all regions, running v2.3.0, with an error rate of 0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api documenting the health-check failures after the v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer has been paged.
